rule: Component order is PARTICIPATION -> TRIP_COUNT -> ACTIVITY_CHAIN -> TIME_SCHEDULE -> DISTANCE_PRIOR.
Runtime inputs are limited to M1, scenario-known context, frozen artifacts and already-generated upstream D_GEN state.
A realised source outcome may be a fitting label but not a predictor of the same generated outcome.
NO_TRIP implies trip_count=0 and zero TripIntent rows.
TRIP_DAY implies integer trip_count>=1.
For a mobile day, number of TripIntent rows equals generated_trip_count.
Activity-chain transitions equal generated_trip_count.
Sequential components may condition only on already-generated prefixes, never future generated states.
Generated time rows must satisfy the frozen temporal schema; invalid generation must be explicit failure/resample, not silent source repair.
D_GEN/TripIntent contains no exact destination coordinate, route geometry or feasible alternatives.
D_GEN does not generate or consume observed/chosen mode as runtime state; mode remains M5.
km_routing is never a D_GEN distance target or runtime feature.
wegkm/distance_prior_km is path-length evidence/prior and is not exact Euclidean OD separation.
P_GEW/W_GEW may weight fit/evaluation but never enter the behavioral feature matrix.
Person/household/source IDs and row keys never enter the behavioral feature matrix.
Quality/eligibility flags select evidence and do not become behavioral predictors.
TEST outcomes remain sealed during F3.1 model-family selection, fitting and calibration.
Low-support strata are flagged/backed off by an explicit future policy; never silently pooled in F3.1a.
Ownership, Access and Availability(t) remain distinct; future dynamic Availability(t) is not D_GEN information.
Trip != Stage; Etappen remains diagnostic-only nonrepresentative evidence.
All F3 outputs retain BERLIN_HYBRID_REFERENCE_V1 provenance and never claim single-year observed Berlin.
Existing household TRAIN/CAL/TEST split is not reopened; descendants inherit household partition.
F3.1a does not select statistical/ML model families; selection is deferred to F3.1b.
Implementation must record component seed namespaces, preprocessing order, candidate ordering when stochastic, config and ModelArtifact hashes.
